title: Finance Tier Shares for Trade-In Chargeback Installments
content:
| Tier's minimum credit score | Tier share |
|---|---|
| 700 or above | 0.85 |
| At least 620 but below 700 | 0.92 |
| Below 620, or no Kestrel Auto Finance contract | One (no reduction) |

The table sets the tier share of today's installment on a **Trade-In Agreements** chargeback shortfall. The tier read is the credit tier of the contract under **Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts** on the purchase the trade is applied to, taken as that tier's minimum credit score.

The share multiplies today's figure once; today's installment is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Boundaries

| Minimum credit score of the tier | Share |
|---|---|
| 619 | One |
| 620 | 0.92 |
| 699 | 0.92 |
| 700 | 0.85 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Today's figure $450.33 on a trade applied to a purchase financed in a tier whose minimum credit score is 660: $450.33 multiplied by 0.92 is $414.3036, which rounds to $414.30.
